spec.rawSql:
SELECT w.window_start, w.window_end, w.data_end,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'min_age') AS min_age
FROM report_window('${reporting_month}'::date) w
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT s.*,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'flag_below_pct') AS flag_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'min_eligible') AS min_eligible
FROM report_statins('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s
WHERE s.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT s.org_unit_id, s.org_unit_name, s.level, s.is_selected, s.too_few, s.flag,
  s.eligible_n, s.on_statin_n, s.on_statin_pct,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'flag_below_pct') AS flag_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'min_eligible') AS min_eligible
FROM report_statins('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

spec.description: Share of eligible patients on a statin at each facility in view. The dashed line marks 25%. Facilities under it are flagged.
spec.title: Eligible patients on a statin, by facility

spec.rawSql:
SELECT s.org_unit_id, s.org_unit_name, s.eligible_n, s.on_statin_n, s.on_statin_pct, s.not_on_statin_n, fl.patients_n
FROM report_statins('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s
JOIN report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) fl ON fl.org_unit_id = s.org_unit_id AND fl.report = 'statins'
WHERE s.flag AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

WITH fl AS (
  SELECT org_unit_id, json_agg(json_build_object('report', report, 'flag_reason', flag_reason, 'patients_n', patients_n)
           ORDER BY report)::text AS flags_json
  FROM report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) GROUP BY org_unit_id
)
SELECT s.*,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'flag_below_pct') AS flag_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'min_eligible') AS min_eligible,
  fl.flags_json
FROM report_statins('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s
LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.org_unit_id = s.org_unit_id
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

options.content: How this is worked out. Eligible means aged 40 or older, with diabetes or a recorded heart attack or stroke. They are alive and had a visit in the last 12 months. On a statin means atorvastatin, simvastatin or rosuvastatin on the latest prescription. A facility under 25% is flagged.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT s.level, s.org_unit_name AS place, s.not_on_statin_n,
  p.patient_id::text AS patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age, p.reason_eligible, p.last_visit_date
FROM report_statins('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s
LEFT JOIN report_statins_patients('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) p ON TRUE
WHERE s.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'
